items.prompt:
Which is a weather-related hazard?
A) Lightning
B) A quiet sunny day
C) A drawing
D) A fossil

steps: Lightning is a weather hazard that can cause harm.

items.prompt:
A lightning rod
A) guides lightning safely into the ground
B) makes more lightning
C) attracts floods
D) does nothing
items.answer: A) guides lightning safely into the ground

steps: It sends lightning safely to the ground.

items.prompt:
A levee is built to
A) hold back floodwater
B) make more rain
C) attract lightning
D) block the Sun

A design solution to a weather hazard has merit if it
A) reduces the harm from the hazard
B) costs the most
C) looks nice only
D) does nothing
items.answer: A) reduces the harm from the hazard

steps: A good solution reduces the hazard's impact.

items.prompt:
A windbreak of trees helps a farm by
A) slowing strong winds before they reach the crops
B) making the wind stronger
C) blocking the Sun
D) attracting floods
items.answer: A) slowing strong winds before they reach the crops

steps: Slowing the wind reduces crop damage.

items.prompt:
Which better resists storm winds?
A) A sturdy, well-attached roof
B) A loose, light roof
C) No roof
D) A paper roof

steps: A well-attached roof resists wind better.

items.prompt:
A town keeps flooding. Building a levee has merit because it
A) makes more rain
B) holds back the water and reduces flooding
C) attracts storms
D) does nothing
items.answer: B) holds back the water and reduces flooding

steps: The levee reduces the flood hazard.

items.prompt:
For a house in a stormy area, which solution has MORE merit?
A) A loose, light roof
B) A sturdy, well-attached roof
C) No roof at all
D) A roof made of paper

steps: It resists storm winds and better protects the house.
